# Jeremiah 50 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 50:2 (overlap: 9%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "Declare among-the-nations and-proclaim, and-lift-up a-banner; proclaim — do-not-hide! Say, 'Babylon is-captured! Bel is-put-to-shame, Marduk is-shattered; her-idols are-put-to-shame, her-images are-broken.'" |
| LOGOS | "Declare among the nations and proclaim, set up a banner and proclaim, conceal it not, and say: 'Babylon is taken, Bel is put to shame, Merodach is dismayed. Her images are put to shame, her idols are dismayed.'" |
| PNEUMA | "Shout it to the nations! Raise the signal flag and announce it! Don't hold anything back! Tell them, 'Babylon has fallen! Bel the god is humiliated, Marduk is shattered. Babylon's idols are disgraced, her false gods broken.'" |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 50:34 (overlap: 14%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Their-Redeemer [is] strong — YHWH-of hosts [is] His-name; He-will-surely-plead their-case, so-that He-may-give-rest to the-land and-unrest to [the]-inhabitants-of Babylon. |
| LOGOS | Their Redeemer is strong; the LORD of hosts is His name. He will surely plead their cause, that He may give rest to the earth but unrest to the inhabitants of Babylon. |
| PNEUMA | But their Redeemer is strong. His name is the LORD of Armies. He will defend them and fight for them so He can bring peace to the land of Israel but turmoil to the people of Babylon. |
